excerpt: Table 1 organizes existing real-time temporal coherence approaches by application and technique. Its rows include pixel shader acceleration, multi-pass effects, shading anti-aliasing, shadows, global illumination, spatio-temporal upsampling, frame interpolation, non-photorealistic rendering, level of detail, streaming, online visibility culling, and temporal perception; its columns include reverse reprojection, forward reprojection, disocclusion handling, cache refresh, amortized sampling, target identification, reprojection error, object-space, and post-processing methods.
overview: This table result supports the source's breadth claim. Temporal coherence is presented as a cross-cutting rendering principle with multiple implementation families, rather than as a single algorithm tied only to pixel shaders or reprojection caches.
title: Temporal Coherence Taxonomy
